column1: # The screens first_save_b2_us.pbwinput (port/tests/oracle) must show on the port, as New Game goes on into the field

# the field's 3D (3d), which only the oracle's comparison holds, within its tolerance, the bottom screen alone. The
# hashes are pbw-oracle's (melonDS 1.1, port/tools/oracle) playing the same file on the player's Black 2 (US) dump, at
# the oracle frame each row names; hashes only. The first nine rows are new_game.screens.tsv's, which the same presses
# show at the same frames. The rest are the field's: the black of the change of map into the house, then the field menu
# in the player's room and its SAVE, on the bottom screen, the clock and the play time with them. The DS shows each of
# the field's up to some 550 frames after the port (its save takes longer); the ranges are the port's own frames, and
